title: Actor ordered to leave India following Mumbai protest participation

tea.why: Protesters gathered at August Kranti Maidan to voice political demands.
tea.want: The resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
tea.changed: Oct 15: Mumbai Police issued a notice to actor Imran Khan to leave India by October 28.

summary: On October 10, a demonstration took place at August Kranti Maidan in Mumbai, where participants demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Among those present was Bollywood actor and US national Imran Khan, who was briefly detained by police during the event. Following a complaint filed by former BJP MP Kirit Somaiya at the Gamdevi police station, Mumbai Police issued a formal notice to the actor directing him to leave the country by October 28 for allegedly violating provisions of the Immigration and Foreigners Act by participating in political activities on Indian soil.
demands: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
response: According to officials, Mumbai Police briefly detained the actor during the demonstration and subsequently served him a formal notice directing him to leave India by October 28 for violating the Immigration and Foreigners Act.

updates.text: Protesters gathered at Mumbai's August Kranti Maidan demanding the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner.
Mumbai Police issued a notice to a foreign national actor directing him to leave the country by October 28.
